title: Adobe Commerce
summary: The Commerce storefront runs on EDS: authored pages plus drop-in components (cart, checkout, PDP, PLP, account) talking to Commerce GraphQL services. This checklist covers the storefront-specific steps before real shoppers arrive.

items.title: Production endpoints
items.detail: Point config.json, Sidekick extensions, sitemap jobs and image import at the same production Commerce GraphQL endpoints.

items.title: Catalog service live
items.detail: Switch the storefront configuration to the production Catalog or Merchandising Services endpoint and headers.

items.title: Drop-ins tested
items.detail: Customize and test every drop-in you use: cart, checkout, product detail, product listing, sign-in and account.

items.title: Test order
items.detail: Walk a test order from add to cart through checkout to confirmation and confirm each step is tracked.

items.title: Product page SEO
items.detail: Give PDPs and PLPs a document title and metadata, and add JSON-LD structured data to product pages.

items.title: Pre-rendered key pages
items.detail: Turn on pre-rendering for key pages so View Source shows metadata and main content in the first HTML response.

items.title: Consent before events
items.detail: Wire consent-check.js to the merchant's CMP so analytics SDKs and collectors stay unloaded until consent.

items.title: CORS restricted
items.detail: Limit CORS on Commerce backends to the origins your storefront and tools actually use.

items.title: Environment Production
items.detail: Change the environment field in the storefront configuration from Testing to Production at launch.

title: AEM Assets & Dynamic Media
summary: EDS can take images from AEM Assets either by copying them into its Media Bus at preview or by linking to Dynamic Media with OpenAPI delivery. The choice drives performance, governance and how asset changes reach the page.

items.title: Delivery approach
items.detail: Decide whether DAM images are copied into the Media Bus at preview or linked from the DAM's own CDN.

items.title: Same-origin LCP
items.detail: With linked DAM assets, route the DAM's CDN through your production domain so the LCP image stays same-origin.

items.title: Links rewritten early
items.detail: Rewrite DAM asset links to picture and img elements early in scripts.js decoration.

items.title: Approved assets
items.detail: Mark assets Approved in AEM Assets before referencing them through Dynamic Media with OpenAPI.

items.title: Within size limits
items.detail: Downscale oversized assets or add edge-delivery-services-* renditions with a processing profile.

items.title: Folder access
items.detail: Grant the publishing technical account access to any private AEM Assets folder used on pages.

items.title: Path mapping
items.detail: Include the DAM folder in the site's path mapping so referenced assets publish with the page.

items.title: Alt text per use
items.detail: Write alt text with the reference on the page, not on the asset, and use empty alt for decorative images.

items.title: Video handling
items.detail: Use a DAM or streaming service for long videos and give short hero MP4s a fast poster image.

title: Forms
summary: EDS forms come in two kinds: document-based forms authored in a spreadsheet, and Adaptive Forms built in Universal Editor with rules and submit actions. Both render through the form block and need a working, safe submission path.

items.title: Authoring mode
items.detail: Use document-based forms for simple field lists and Universal Editor forms for rules, panels and data integrations.

items.title: Forms block in repo
items.detail: Add the Adaptive Forms Block to the existing project or start from the forms boilerplate.

items.title: Incoming sheet
items.detail: For sheet submissions, add an incoming sheet with field-name headers, then preview the workbook again.

items.title: No PII in sheets
items.detail: Keep personal or sensitive data out of shared-aem and shared-default sheets, which can be read publicly.

items.title: Submit URL
items.detail: Set submitBaseUrl in blocks/form/constant.js to the right AEM publish URL, with no trailing slash.

items.title: CORS and referrer
items.detail: Allow aem.page and aem.live origins in dispatcher CORS and the referrer filter so submissions reach AEM.

items.title: Spam protection
items.detail: Add reCAPTCHA Enterprise with a score-based site key to Universal Editor forms.

items.title: Thank-you message
items.detail: Customize the message visitors see after a successful submission.

items.title: Live test submission
items.detail: Submit a test entry on the live URL and confirm it arrives in the sheet or target system.

title: Site search
summary: Most EDS sites search the query index JSON in the browser, as the Block Collection search block does; catalogs use a search service such as the Commerce Product Discovery drop-in. Search is only as good as the index behind it.

items.title: Pick the engine
items.detail: Search content with the query index and use a dedicated search service for large catalogs.

items.title: Index the fields
items.detail: Index title, description, image and lastModified so results have something useful to show.

items.title: Selectors on source
items.detail: Write index selectors against served HTML, not the decorated DOM, and check them with aem up --print-index.

items.title: Index on publish
items.detail: Pages enter the index on publish and leave on unpublish; reindex after changing the index config.

items.title: Noindex filtered
items.detail: Keep drafts out with exclude paths and filter noindex pages out using the robots property.

items.title: Paginate the JSON
items.detail: Use limit and offset to fetch past the default 1000 rows of the index JSON.

items.title: Accessible results
items.detail: Label the search input and announce results in an aria-live region.

items.title: Linkable query
items.detail: Keep the search term in the q parameter so result pages can be shared and reloaded.

items.title: No-results message
items.detail: Show an authored no-results message from placeholders instead of an empty list.

title: Cloud Manager & domains
summary: Adding an EDS site to Cloud Manager ties it to your license and lets you run domains, certificates and the Adobe-managed CDN in one place. This checklist walks the onboarding to a live custom domain.

items.title: EDS license on program
items.detail: Create the program with an Edge Delivery Services license before onboarding the site.

items.title: Add the site
items.detail: Add the site under Edge Delivery Sites with a clear name and its main--site--org.aem.live origin.

items.title: Verify repo ownership
items.detail: Merge well-known/adobe/cloudmanager-challenge.txt with the given code to main, then click Verify.

items.title: Auth paused to verify
items.detail: If site authentication is on, turn it off briefly so the challenge file can be read, then back on.

items.title: Certs and domains
items.detail: Add certificates and domains in Cloud Manager for both the www and apex hosts.

items.title: CDN maps to main
items.detail: Add a CDN configuration that maps the domain to an origin starting with main-- for caching and purge.

items.title: Push invalidation
items.detail: Set the cdn prod host and type managed in the site configuration so publishes purge the CDN.

items.title: DNS records
items.detail: Point www CNAME to cdn.adobeaemcloud.com and apex A records to the documented IPs, with a TTL of an hour or more.

items.title: Redirects in place
items.detail: Rely on the apex-to-www redirect and put every other redirect in the redirects sheet.

title: GitHub & Code Sync
summary: EDS serves code straight from GitHub: the AEM Code Sync app syncs each push, and every branch gets its own preview and live URL. Repoless sites reuse one repo through the Configuration Service.

items.title: Code Sync scoped
items.detail: Install the AEM Code Sync app with Only select repositories and pick just the site repo.

items.title: Public by default
items.detail: Keep the repo public where policy allows; private repos also work with Code Sync installed.

items.title: Short branch names
items.detail: Keep branch--repo--owner within 63 characters and never use -- inside any of the three names.

items.title: Branch previews
items.detail: Review each feature branch at its own branch--repo--owner.aem.page URL before merging.

items.title: PSI check passes
items.detail: Let the PageSpeed Insights check on each pull request pass before you merge.

items.title: Production on main
items.detail: Serve production only from main; other branches get different cache headers and no push invalidation.

items.title: .hlxignore
items.detail: List tests, build tools and other non-site files in .hlxignore so they are not served.

items.title: Config Service
items.detail: Keep content source, folders, robots and indexes in the Configuration Service; fstab.yaml is legacy document mode.

items.title: Repoless reuse
items.detail: Point extra sites at the canonical repo through the Admin API instead of copying repositories.
